title: Corner Resize Couples Only Touching Joins
description: ui: resizing on corners must work for all participating windows and preview all directions. e.g. cad has four windows that share a corner but when I move only the right two change height and the left two are not changing height correctly. Fix so a shared + junction corner drag resizes every participating axis (main + all peer cross axes) live in all directions.
summary:
Corner peer coupling was sticky because join fractions used even i/count, so left/right always matched at 0.5 after an independent vertical resize.

Fix: modePerpendicularJoinSeparators now uses size-weighted cumulative fractions. resolveJoinCornerPeerCrossAxes only peers joins within MODE_JOIN_CORNER_TOUCH_EPS, so a misaligned corner resizes only its own windows; a true + junction (corners touching) still resizes all four.

Verified: 7 focused vitest cases pass (aligned peers, misaligned isolation, applyModeJoinCornerResize both paths, placement, Mode pointer drag).
